answer: Lock each work record for 30 days. Renew it with fresh work before expiry. Expired records stop counting as history and drop from the score. Idle agents bleed standing every epoch they skip. A comet of 200 identities needs 200 renewals inside 30 days. The prism splits one operator into many addresses, but the record clock does not. Cost: continuous work, not a one-time registration. Signal per identity stays near zero without it.
